prov.heading: Allowance for Credit Losses
prov.text: During the second quarter of 2026, the Company completed its annual review of the allowance for credit losses methodology and refined certain assumptions and model inputs used in estimating expected credit losses within its existing CECL framework. The refinements included updates to the reasonable and supportable forecast period, which was extended from four quarters to eight quarters, and certain model inputs. These refinements were implemented through the Company's regular model governance and review process and reflect management's current assessment of portfolio dynamics and the period over which forecast information is considered sufficiently reliable for estimating expected credit losses.

nonint.text: Non-interest expense. During the three months ended September 30, 2026, non-interest expense totaled $15.1 million, an increase of $11 thousand from the three months ended September 30, 2025. The four largest increases were $341 thousand in professional fees, $272 thousand in occupancy and equipment, $222 thousand in salaries and employee benefits, and $178 thousand in loan collection expenses. The largest reduction in non-interest expense was $879 thousand in merger expenses incurred during the third quarter of 2025. Management estimates that approximately $350 thousand of the professional fees and loan collection expenses recognized during the current quarter were nonrecurring in nature.

nonop.text: Interest expense on deposits increased by $197 thousand related to an increase of $24.6 million in average balance of interest-bearing deposits and a 4 basis point increase in the average rate paid on interest-bearing deposits. The average rate paid on interest-bearing deposits increased from 1.56% during the third quarter of 2025 to 1.60% during the current quarter, primarily due to an increase in the average rate paid on time deposits from 1.87% in the third quarter of 2025 to 2.77% during the current quarter. These increases were partially offset by a decrease in the average rate paid on money market deposits from 2.22% in the third quarter of 2025 to 1.79% during the current quarter.

pretax.text: Net interest income before provision for credit losses. Net interest income increased by $1.3 million from $25.2 million during the three months ended September 30, 2025, to $26.5 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026. The increase in net interest income reflects an increase of $1.3 million in interest income and a $113 thousand decrease in interest expense.

tax.text: Provision for income taxes. The provision for income taxes increased $877 thousand to $2.6 million during the current quarter from $1.8 million during the third quarter of 2025, due to higher pre-tax earnings. The percentages for 2026 and 2025 differ from statutory rates as tax exempt items of income such as earnings on BOLI and municipal securities interest decrease taxable income while non-deductible merger transaction costs incurred during the 2025 quarter effectively increase taxable income. The effective tax rate declined to 18.9% from 25.6% in the prior-year quarter, related to the purchase of $14.5 million in green energy tax credits at a discount resulting in a $1.1 million reduction in the provision for income taxes in the third quarter of 2026.

net.text: Net Income. The Company recorded net income of $11.4 million, or $1.64 per share, an increase of $6.2 million from $5.1 million or $0.74 per share, during the third quarter of 2025. Diluted earnings per share increased to $1.61 per share during the three months ended September 30, 2026, up from $0.73 per share during the quarter ended September 30, 2025. Return on average assets was 1.98% during the current quarter, up from 0.90% during the third quarter of 2025. Return on average equity increased to 16.7% during the current quarter, up from 8.5% during the third quarter of 2025.

Net interest income.text: Net interest income increased by $1.3 million from $25.2 million during the three months ended September 30, 2025, to $26.5 million during the current quarter. The provision for credit losses decreased from $5.4 million during the third quarter of 2025 to $150 thousand during the current quarter. Non-interest income increased by $538 thousand from $2.2 million during the three months ended September 30, 2025, to $2.8 million during the third quarter of 2026. Non-interest expense was flat compared to the third quarter of 2025 at $15.1 million.The provision for income taxes increased $877 thousand to $2.6 million during the current quarter from $1.8 million during the third quarter of 2025, due to higher pre-tax earnings. The effective tax rate declined to 18.9% from 25.6% in the prior-year quarter, related to the purchase of $14.5 million in green energy tax credits.

intro.text: References in this report to the “Company,” “we,” “us” and “our” refer to Plumas Bancorp and its consolidated subsidiary, unless the context indicates otherwise. References to the “Bank” refer to Company’s wholly-owned subsidiary, Plumas Bank. References to “Management” refer to the members of the Company’s management and references to the “Board of Directors” or the “Board” refer to the Company’s Board of Directors. The Company . Plumas Bancorp is a bank holding company headquartered in Reno, Nevada. Substantially all of the Company's operations are conducted through its subsidiary, Plumas Bank, which is also the principal source of the Company’s revenue.

accounts.note: Securities bought and sold sit in 'other investing' with everything else the section does not name.

accounts.name: Property, plant and equipment
accounts.note: Depreciation and amortisation includes the amortisation of intangibles where the filing reports one line: the PP&E residual then carries the intangibles' share.

accounts.name: Goodwill and intangibles
accounts.note: Acquisitions add goodwill and intangibles at their allocated values, not at the cash paid; the residual is the difference and the amortisation.

accounts.name: Equity
accounts.note: Other comprehensive income (currency translation, unrealised gains) moves equity without passing through net income: it is in the residual.
